parameters.name: access_key
parameters.description: AWS access key ID. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID or AWS_ACCESS_KEY environment variables may also be used in decreasing order of preference. The aws_access_key and profile options are mutually exclusive. The aws_access_key_id alias was added in release 5.1.0 for consistency with the AWS botocore SDK.

parameters.name: aws_ca_bundle
parameters.description: The location of a CA Bundle to use when validating SSL certificates. The AWS_CA_BUNDLE environment variable may also be used.

parameters.name: aws_config
parameters.description: A dictionary to modify the botocore configuration. Parameters can be found in the AWS documentation https://botocore.amazonaws.com/v1/documentation/api/latest/reference/config.html#botocore.config.Config.

parameters.name: backup_plan_name
parameters.description: Uniquely identifies the backup plan to be associated with the selection of resources.

parameters.name: backup_selection_name
parameters.description: The display name of a resource selection document. Must contain 1 to 50 alphanumeric or ‘-_.’ characters.

parameters.name: conditions
parameters.description: A list of conditions (expressed as a dict) that you define to assign resources to your backup plans using tags. When you specify more than one condition in conditions, you only assign the resources that match ALL conditions (using AND logic). conditions supports string_equals, string_like, string_not_equals, and string_not_like. list_of_tags only supports string_equals.

parameters.name: string_equals
parameters.description: Filters the values of your tagged resources for only those resources that you tagged with the same value. Default: []

parameters.name: condition_key
parameters.description: The key in a key-value pair. conditions.string_equals.condition_key in the conditions option must use the AWS resource tag prefix, e.g. ‘aws:ResourceTag/key-name’

parameters.name: condition_value
parameters.description: The value in a key-value pair.

parameters.name: string_like
parameters.description: Filters the values of your tagged resources for matching tag values with the use of a wildcard character (*) anywhere in the string. For example, “prod*” or “*rod*” matches the tag value “production”. Default: []

parameters.name: string_not_equals
parameters.description: Filters the values of your tagged resources for only those resources that you tagged that do not have the same value. Default: []

parameters.name: string_not_like
parameters.description: Filters the values of your tagged resources for non-matching tag values with the use of a wildcard character (*) anywhere in the string. Default: []

parameters.name: debug_botocore_endpoint_logs
parameters.description: Use a botocore.endpoint logger to parse the unique (rather than total) "resource:action" API calls made during a task, outputing the set to the resource_actions key in the task results. Use the aws_resource_action callback to output to total list made during a playbook. The ANSIBLE_DEBUG_BOTOCORE_LOGS environment variable may also be used. Choices: false ← (default) true

parameters.name: endpoint_url
parameters.description: URL to connect to instead of the default AWS endpoints. While this can be used to connection to other AWS-compatible services the amazon.aws and community.aws collections are only tested against AWS. The AWS_URL environment variable may also be used.

parameters.name: iam_role_arn
parameters.description: The ARN of the IAM role that Backup uses to authenticate when backing up the target resource.

parameters.name: list_of_tags
parameters.description: A list of conditions that you define to assign resources to your backup plans using tags. Condition operators are case sensitive. When you specify more than one condition in list_of_tags, you assign all resources that match AT LEAST ONE condition (using OR logic).

parameters.name: condition_type
parameters.description: An operation applied to a key-value pair used to assign resources to your backup plan. Condition only supports STRINGEQUALS.

parameters.name: not_resources
parameters.description: A list of Amazon Resource Names (ARNs) to exclude from a backup plan. The maximum number of ARNs is 500 without wildcards, or 30 ARNs with wildcards. If you need to exclude many resources from a backup plan, consider a different resource selection strategy, such as assigning only one or a few resource types or refining your resource selection using tags.

parameters.name: profile
parameters.description: A named AWS profile to use for authentication. See the AWS documentation for more information about named profiles https://docs.aws.amazon.com/cli/latest/userguide/cli-configure-profiles.html. The AWS_PROFILE environment variable may also be used. The profile option is mutually exclusive with the aws_access_key, aws_secret_key and session_token options.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: The AWS region to use. For global services such as IAM, Route53 and CloudFront, region is ignored. The AWS_REGION environment variable may also be used. See the Amazon AWS documentation for more information http://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/rande.html#ec2_region.

parameters.name: resources
parameters.description: A list of Amazon Resource Names (ARNs) to assign to a backup plan. The maximum number of ARNs is 500 without wildcards, or 30 ARNs with wildcards. If you need to assign many resources to a backup plan, consider a different resource selection strategy, such as assigning all resources of a resource type or refining your resource selection using tags.

parameters.name: secret_key
parameters.description: AWS secret access key. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY or AWS_SECRET_KEY environment variables may also be used in decreasing order of preference. The secret_key and profile options are mutually exclusive. The aws_secret_access_key alias was added in release 5.1.0 for consistency with the AWS botocore SDK.

parameters.name: session_token
parameters.description: AWS STS session token for use with temporary credentials. See the AWS documentation for more information about access tokens https://docs.aws.amazon.com/general/latest/gr/aws-sec-cred-types.html#access-keys-and-secret-access-keys. The AWS_SESSION_TOKEN environment variable may also be used. The session_token and profile options are mutually exclusive.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Create, delete a backup selection. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: When set to false, SSL certificates will not be validated for communication with the AWS APIs. Setting validate_certs=false is strongly discouraged, as an alternative, consider setting aws_ca_bundle instead. Choices: false true ← (default)

examples:
- name: Create backup selection
  amazon.aws.backup_selection:
    selection_name: elastic
    backup_plan_name: test-backup-plan
    iam_role_arn: arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/system-backup
    resources:
      - arn:aws:elasticfilesystem:*:*:file-system/*

- name: Create backup selection, assign resources using tags
  amazon.aws.backup_selection:
    selection_name: elastic
    backup_plan_name: test-backup-plan
    iam_role_arn: arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/system-backup
    list_of_tags:
      - condition_type: STRINGEQUALS
        condition_key: Owner
        condition_value: Dev01

return_values.name: backup_plan_id
return_values.description: ID of the backup plan. Returned: always Sample: "1111f877-1ecf-4d79-9718-a861cd09df3b"

return_values.name: conditions
return_values.description: A list of conditions that defines how resources are assigned to backup plans using tags. Returned: always Sample: {"string_equals": [], "string_like": [], "string_not_equals": [], "string_not_like": []}

return_values.name: string_equals
return_values.description: Filters the values of tagged resources for only those resources that are tagged with the same value. Returned: always Sample: []

return_values.name: string_like
return_values.description: Filters the values of tagged resources for matching tag values with the use of a wildcard character (*) anywhere in the string. Returned: always Sample: []

return_values.name: string_not_equals
return_values.description: Filters the values of tagged resources for only those resources that are not tagged with the same value. Returned: always Sample: []

return_values.name: string_not_like
return_values.description: Filters the values of tagged resources for non-matching tag values with the use of a wildcard character (*) anywhere in the string. Returned: always Sample: []

return_values.name: creation_date
return_values.description: Creation date of the backup plan. Returned: on create/update Sample: "2023-01-24T10:08:03.193000+01:00"

return_values.name: iam_role_arn
return_values.description: The ARN of the IAM role that Backup uses to authenticate when backing up the target resource. Returned: always Sample: "arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/system-backup"

return_values.name: list_of_tags
return_values.description: Conditions defined to assign resources to the backup plans using tags. Returned: always Sample: [{"condition_key": "Environment", "condition_type": "STRINGEQUALS", "condition_value": "Dev"}]

return_values.name: condition_key
return_values.description: The key in a key-value pair. Returned: always Sample: "Environment"

return_values.name: condition_type
return_values.description: An operation applied to a key-value pair used to assign resources to backup plan. Returned: always Sample: "STRINGEQUALS"

return_values.name: condition_value
return_values.description: The value in a key-value pair. Returned: always Sample: "Dev"

return_values.name: not_resources
return_values.description: List of Amazon Resource Names (ARNs) that are excluded from the backup plan. Returned: always Sample: []

return_values.name: resources
return_values.description: List of Amazon Resource Names (ARNs) that are assigned to the backup plan. Returned: always Sample: []

return_values.name: selection_id
return_values.description: Backup selection id. Returned: always Sample: "1111c217-5d71-4a55-8728-5fc4e63d437b"

return_values.name: selection_name
return_values.description: The display name of a resource selection document. Returned: always Sample: "elastic"
